items.raw_excerpt: Cyberabad Traffic Police impose 60-day traffic diversions near Khajaguda Junction for water pipelines, guiding three detours around Nanakramguda and IT corridor.
items.summary_en: Cyberabad police will close some roads near Khajaguda Junction for 60 days. The work is to lay new water pipelines. Drivers are asked to use three other roads around Nanakramguda and the main tech corridor instead.
items.summary_ko: 사이버가바드 경찰은 카자가우다 교차로 주변 도로를 60일간 통행 제한한다. 새 수도관을 놓기 위한 조치다. 경찰은 나나크람구다와 정보기술 도로 구간을 이용하는 우회로 세 곳을 안내했다.
items.title_en: Road Closures Near Khajaguda Junction for 60 Days; Police Offer Three Detour Routes
items.title_ko: 카자가우다 교차로 60일간 통행 제한, 사이버가바드 경찰이 우회로 세 곳 안내
items.title_original: Khajaguda junction restrictions may push traffic onto internal roads; Cyberabad Police map three alternative routes

items.raw_excerpt: With AI, economic shifts and a tightening job market making traditional roles feel less secure, many internationals are looking for a fresh start. We spoke to an expert about how to successfully switch careers in Germany.
items.summary_en: An expert says people should stay curious when they want to change careers in Germany. Many foreign workers look for a new start as AI and a tighter job market change the work market.
items.summary_ko: 직업을 바꾸려는 사람들에게 호기심을 유지하라고 조언한 전문가가 있다. AI와 Occupy 좁아지는 노동시장으로 외국인 노동자들이 새 출발을 찾는 Vinext가 늘고 있다.
items.title_en: Expert Gives Job Change Advice in Germany

items.title_original: ‘Get curious’: Expert advice on how to change careers in Germany

items.raw_excerpt: There are plenty of fantastic festivals taking place across France in October, from jazz and electronic music to wine and food. Here are seven to get in your diary and there's something for almost everyone's taste.
items.summary_en: Many small festivals run across France in October. They cover jazz, electronic music, wine, and food. We picked seven good ones for your calendar, and there is one for almost everyone.

items.raw_excerpt: Tessa Virtue, the three-time Olympic champion ice dancer, will make her stage debut — without skates — in a new solo contemporary dance performance at the Fall For Dance North Festival in Toronto.
items.summary_en: Tessa Virtue, a three-time Olympic champion in ice dancing, will star in a new solo dance show. She performs it at the Fall For Dance North Festival in Toronto. She says dancing without skates feels terrifying and invigorating at the same time.
items.summary_ko: 얼음댄싱에서 올림픽 금메달을 세 번 얻은 테사 버츄가 새 솔로 공연을 한다. 공연은 캐나다 토론토의 폴 포 댄스 노스 페스티벌에서 열린다. 스케이트를 신지 않고 춤추는 것이 무섭지만 동시에 활력을 준다고 말한다.
items.title_en: Olympic skater Tessa Virtue takes the stage without skates

items.title_original: Tessa Virtue says taking on dance without skates is 'terrifying' and 'invigorating'

items.raw_excerpt: Keep up to date with all of the latest developments as residents remain on the Garvaghy Road on the third day of the Drumcree dispute.
items.summary_en: The government mediator in the Drumcree dispute says he thinks there will be a decision on the Orangemen parade. Residents on Garvaghy Road stayed on the road on the third day. The dispute is about whether the parade will pass the Orange Order area.
items.summary_ko: 드럼크리 분쟁의 정부 중재자가 오렌지맨단 행진 허용 여부는 결정이 날 가능성이 높다고 말했다. 가르바기 로드에 살던 주민들은 사흘째 길목을 지켰다. 이 분쟁은 오렌지맨단 구역을 행진이 지나갈 수 있는지를 둘러싸고 이어져 온 다툼이다.

items.raw_excerpt: Central Tokyo on Tuesday registered 34 consecutive days of rain, marking the longest streak on record, according to the weather agency. The area has seen precipitation since Aug 27, with approaching typhoons, a stalled autumn rain front and a trough of low pressure contributing to the rain. The previous record…
items.summary_en: Central Tokyo had rain for 34 days in a row. This is the longest rain streak ever recorded there. Rain since late August, two typhoons, and a stuck autumn rain front all added to it.
items.summary_ko: 도쿄 한복판에 34일 연속으로 비가 왔습니다. 역대 최장 기록입니다. 8월 말부터 계속된 비에 typhoon과 정체된 가을 비 fronts가 겹쳐 한 waterspout 기록이 이어졌습니다.
items.title_en: Central Tokyo has rain for 34 days in a row, the longest ever

items.raw_excerpt: In a social media post on Monday (Sep 28), Luna said it will close its doors on Dec 31.
items.summary_en: The popular patisserie Luna will close its doors on Dec 31. The owner announced this on social media on Sep 28. The shop blames rising costs for the closing.

items.summary_en: The ferry IONIS had a mechanical problem near the island of Kea and was not allowed to leave port. Workers fixed the broken machinery. The sailing ban was then lifted, so the ship can travel from Kea to Lavrio again.
items.summary_ko: 키아 섬 근처에서 승객선 IONIS가 기계 고장으로 출항을 못 하는 상황이 발생했다. 정비 작업으로 고장 난 기계가 수리됐다. 이후 출항 금지 해제가 내려져 배는 다시 키아에서 라우리오로 항해할 수 있게 됐다.

items.raw_excerpt: There is perhaps no better example of an independent business than the neighborhood used bookstore. But like many such businesses these days, it can be really hard to make ends meet as they compete with cheaper chain stores or faster and more convenient electronic alternatives. So at first, it must…
items.summary_en: Used book shops in Japan are selling huge piles of old books to one mystery buyer. Small shops say they cannot match the prices this buyer offers. No one knows who is placing the big orders.
items.summary_ko: 일본 중고책집에 정체불명의 손님이 책 더미를 통째로 사 간다. 작은 서점들은 그 손님이 내놓는 값에 맞출 수 없다고 말한다. 그렇게 대량으로 주문하는 사람이 누구인지는 아무도 모른다.
items.title_en: Someone Unknown Is Buying Up Japan's Used Books by the Ton
